items.item: Incremental indexing without blocking the UI
Notes answers with every claim tied to a source file
Stage gate: unsupported claim shown as unsupported
Ask about code, get a diff, never an edit
Retrieval stays fast as folder grows

bugs.title: An irrelevant file is cited as the source of an answer that says it could not find it
bugs.repro: notes_user: ask 'what is the budget for project orion?' (and 'what is the Phoenix budget?' before Check for changes)
bugs.evidence: q0: 'I could not find it. budget 2026.xlsx:1 Sources: budget 2026.xlsx:1'; phoenix before check returned 'sample content of budget 2026.xlsx' as the answer. Reproduced 2x. Orion budget is really in notes.txt.

bugs.title: Retrieval misses facts that are in the files (false NOT FOUND, inconsistent)
bugs.repro: notes_user: 'who is the owner of Orion and when is the deadline?' then 'summarise my notes'; big folder: 'which files mention subject 5?'
bugs.evidence: Owner/deadline NOT FOUND while the summary returned Sara Khan and 14 March from notes.txt. Big folder subject-5 question NOT FOUND though about 24 files match. Works: January meeting, lecture 3, shout, README, document 123, hardware risks. Likely the known missing embedding model.

bugs.title: With a folder selected, a count question makes the assistant ask which folder
bugs.repro: Select big, ask 'how many documents are there about subject 3?'
bugs.evidence: Reply asked which folder or files to look in although big (400 files) was selected.

bugs.title: Citations repeat and always say line 1
bugs.evidence: 'notes.txt:1, notes.txt:1'; every citation is ':1' even for later lines (q5.png).

undesired.title: No visible indexing progress
undesired.detail: 400-file add took about 3 s showing only the generic processing timer, then 'Added big. ...400 files'. UI stayed responsive but nothing says indexing is happening.

undesired.title: Vague code request does not find the code
undesired.detail: 'there is a bug in add(), please fix it' got 'show me the code file that has add()' though app/main.py is in the folder; naming the file gave the diff.

undesired.title: 'Nothing ran.' for a missing file
undesired.detail: 'what is in the file called secrets.txt?' answers only 'Nothing ran.'

undesired.title: Rewrite request on a note just echoes it
undesired.detail: 'rewrite notes.txt to be shorter and save it' shows the file text, no diff or explanation; file unchanged on disk.

undesired.title: Two different unsupported wordings
undesired.detail: 'NOT FOUND IN YOUR FILES ... not backed by a file' vs 'I could not find it.' plus a source line; the second hides the unsupported state.

undesired.title: Talk panel pushes answers below the fold; fresh install says pick up where we left off
undesired.detail: Expanded Talk section is tall so the reply is off screen after Ask. A brand-new data folder greets 'Hi again. Let us pick up where we left off.'

undesired.title: New files unseen until Check for changes (known)
undesired.detail: Before the check the Phoenix question got an unrelated file (see B1); after it answered correctly and What changed said 'added: phoenix.txt'.
